about_the_game:
INTERESTED IN FOLLOWING DEVELOPMENT?

Follow @cardboard_animal on Youtube and Instagram!!

Sheeps is a first-person poetry game set in a small open world. Each of the game's over 200 poems is contained within a sheep. Feed the sheep to the giant tree to hear the poem inside. There is no damage or game-overs, just the poems and the serene world around you.

Unlock new abilities and areas.

As more poems are read, the world expands in size and more sheeps are able to be found. Finding items and completing tasks can reward you with new ways to move about and experience the world.

Meet the characters.

Characters from certain poems will show up in the world after listening. Fully voice-acted, speak to them to learn more about their history and personality.

Listen to the sounds.

Sheeps contains over 90 minutes of Original Sound Track by artist KLLED. The rich ambient music will wash over you along with the sounds of nature.

Support your public library.

The poems you read will be donated as books to the local Public Library. Go there to speak to reread poems, talk to the patrons, or decorate your very own Zen Garden. Use the Zen Garden to equip different abilities as you unlock them.

short_description: Kill a sheep - Feed it to a tree - Listen to a poem. Sheeps is a poem-based adventure in a small open-world. Find 200+ poems contained within the sheeps roaming the world. As more poems are read, explore more of the world and interact with the characters from the poems.
